meta.name: competitors
meta.description: When the user wants to create competitor comparison or alternative pages for SEO and sales enablement. Also use when the user mentions 'alternative page,' 'vs page,' 'competitor comparison,' 'comparison page,' '[Product] vs [Product],' '[Product] alternative,' 'competitive landing pages,' 'how do we compare to X,' 'battle card,' or 'competitor teardown.' Use this for any content that positions your product against competitors. Covers four formats: singular alternative, plural alternatives, you vs competitor, and competitor vs competitor. For sales-specific competitor docs, see sales-enablement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成竞品对比与替代页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常制作官网竞品页或销售对比材料
copy.tagline_en: Create competitor comparison and alternative pages for SEO and sales.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly write web pages comparing your product with competitors.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要做竞品对比或替代页时,Claude 会按四种格式(单一替代、多个替代、我方vs对手、对手vs对手)组织页面,并给出页面结构模板、竞品研究方法、定价与功能对比框架,以及 SEO 关键词和内部链接建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“替代页”“vs 页”“竞品对比”等关键词,或要求做任何把自己产品与竞品放在一起的内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个“Notion 替代”页面
say.note: Claude 会按单一替代格式给出页面结构。

say.text: 写一篇“我们 vs Asana”的对比页
say.note: Claude 会按“你 vs 对手”格式组织内容。

say.text: 做一张我们和两个竞品的三方对比表
say.note: Claude 会按对手vs对手格式,把我们作为第三方纳入。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a competitor comparison or alternative page, Claude structures it in one of four formats, then provides page templates, research guidance, pricing/feature comparison framework, and SEO/linking advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "alternative page," "vs page," "competitor comparison," or similar, or asks for any content positioning a product against competitors.

say_en.note: Claude builds the singular alternative format.

say_en.text: Write a "Us vs Asana" comparison page.
Make a three-way comparison of us and two competitors.
say_en.note: Claude covers competitor-vs-competitor and adds you as third option.
